subject: Discovery recap & next steps — data handling / logging constraints (Finova)
body:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
To: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@finovapay.com>
Cc: Evan Hart <evan.hart@finovapay.com>, Dev Patel <dev.patel@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Wed, 04 Mar 2026 15:12:00 -0700
Subject: Discovery recap & next steps — data handling / logging constraints (Finova)

Hi Laura / Evan —

Thanks again for taking time today. Quick recap from our discovery so we have a shared baseline and clear next steps. I’ve kept this tight; please flag anything I missed.

Pain points you shared
- Primary: client-sensitive PII in customer messages (payment identifiers, masked PANs in some logs) — needs strict handling and demonstrable deletion.
- Audit & compliance: internal auditors need per-request audit logs and immutable traces for any data access, plus SOC 2 evidence.
- Retention: legal requires retention configurable by dataset, with 30-day default and ability to set shorter windows and enforce deletion on request.
- Redaction: automated redaction of standardized PII (emails, SSNs, PAN tokens) before any persistent logging; manual redaction hooks for edge cases.

Current stack you described
- Ingest: Kafka -> validation service (Postgres) -> S3 for attachments; inference currently called from a containerized service in EKS.
- Key ownership: customer-managed KMS for production keys; staging uses AWS KMS under Finova account.

Success criteria (what will make a PoC successful)
- No customer-identifiable PII persists in logs for hosted inference (or a clearly documented, auditable exception when Private is required).
- Token-level redaction or pre-send redaction hook available to Finova engineers.
- Retention policy configurable per environment + documented deletion SLA.
- Straightforward roadmap to integrate with your KMS/HSM and provide SOC 2 audit artifacts.

Items we’ll follow up on
- Security deep-dive with our engineering/security team (Rishi, Dev) — propose Thu 3/12 at 11:00 AM PT.
- Provide the draft Mutual Action Plan (attached) and our security Q&A (attached).
- Confirm procurement timeline and required legal docs (copying Finova legal on next thread as requested).

Attachments: Finova_Mutual_Action_Plan_v1.xlsx, Redwood_Security_QA_v2026-03.pdf

Next steps (owners)
- Marissa: move MAP to HubSpot and set tentative PoC dates (I’ll do before EOD Fri 3/6).
- Rishi: prepare a short note on how Redwood handles logs/retention and options for hosted vs private deployments (Rishi to send by Tue 3/10).
- Dev: scope any infra changes required for KMS/HSM integration once we agree on the PoC variant.

Appreciate the clarity today — I’ll hold the Thu slot provisionally.

Best,
Marissa Cole
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com | +1 (415) 555-0194

From: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@finovapay.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Evan Hart <evan.hart@finovapay.com>
Date: Thu, 05 Mar 2026 09:04:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Discovery recap & next steps — data handling / logging constraints (Finova)

Marissa —

Thanks for the notes. This aligns with our internal readout. A couple quick clarifications before the security deep-dive:

1) When you say “no customer-identifiable PII persists in logs for hosted inference,” can you confirm whether Redwood stores request/response payloads (even short-term) in hosted mode? If so, what exactly is logged and where (S3/buckets in which account)?

2) Can you describe the automated redaction steps? Do you provide a pre-send sanitizer we can run in our service, or is it an on-platform redaction step? Is it rule-based, ML-based, or both?

3) Deletion SLA: we need a written commitment for deletion of residuals or traces in your hosted system. Our legal team will likely want a 24–72 hour window.

Procurement: we are targeting vendor selection by end of March; a short PoC in April would be ideal.

Thanks — copying our CISO Evan for visibility.

Laura Bennett
Head of Product, Integrations | Finova Payments
laura.bennett@finovapay.com | +1 (212) 555-0122

From: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwoodinference.com>
To: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@finovapay.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Dev Patel <dev.patel@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Thu, 05 Mar 2026 13:36:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Discovery recap & next steps — data handling / logging constraints (Finova)

Hi Laura / Marissa —

Appreciate the questions. Short answers first, then a bit more detail to prep for the deep-dive.

1) Do we store request/response payloads in Hosted mode?
- Default Hosted behavior: request metadata (request id, timestamp, model, route, token counts, latency) is retained for 7 days by default for observability and billing. Full request/response payloads are not retained persistently unless you enable debug logging for a specific route or explicitly opt into storing transcripts.
- When debug or transcript storage is enabled, payloads are stored encrypted at rest in AWS S3 under Redwood-managed buckets in our production account for Hosted customers. For Dedicated/Private, buckets live in customer-managed accounts or on-prem stores.

2) Redaction approach
- We offer three options:
  a) Pre-send sanitizer (recommended): a small open-source library you run in your service before calling our API; it applies deterministic rule-based redaction (emails, SSN/PAN patterns) and can be extended with custom regexes.
  b) On-platform redaction: Redwood can run an ML-assisted redaction step before any payload is persisted. This runs in the serving path and can be configured to drop or token-replace detected PII.
  c) Hybrid: pre-send sanitizer + on-platform verification (best for sensitive flows).
- We provide sample regex packs and a CLI to test on sample logs. We’ll bring those artifacts to the deep-dive.

3) Deletion SLA and evidence
- Hosted: we commit to removing non-billing telemetry payloads within 48 hours of a verified deletion request; billing and aggregated metrics are retained as anonymized aggregates. We provide a deletion confirmation report and an audit entry.
- Dedicated/Private: retention and deletion are controlled by your policy (we provide guidance and scripts).

4) Audit logs and SOC 2
- Per-request audit trails (who/when/what) are available in Dedicated and Private deployments; for Hosted we surface audit events via our console and can provide extracts for SOC 2 evidence.
- We are SOC 2 Type II compliant; I will attach the current attestation in the security packet for the deep-dive.

Recommendations for the PoC
- Start with a Hosted PoC using the pre-send sanitizer + on-platform verification (hybrid) so your team can validate redaction coverage quickly.
- If Finova policy requires no-hosted-payloads at all, recommend a Dedicated or Private deployment for the PoC so buckets and audit logs live in your account.

I’ll bring a small demo that shows: sanitizer in action, tokens redacted, and a mock deletion request and confirmation.

Attaching: Redwood_Security_QA_v2026-03.pdf (full answers + attestation links).

Regards,
Rishi Malhotra
Senior Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference
rishi.malhotra@redwoodinference.com

Date: Fri, 06 Mar 2026 09:08:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Discovery recap & next steps — data handling / logging constraints (Finova)

Laura / Evan —

Thanks for the quick follow-up and excellent questions. Confirming the proposed next steps and adding a couple of administrative items so procurement/legal have what they need: 

Action items
- Marissa: Lock Thu 3/12 11:00 AM PT for the security deep-dive (invite inbound); add Finova legal contact and procurement to the calendar. (Due: 3/08)
- Rishi: Share the short tech note and sample sanitizer + regex pack (Due: 3/10).
- Dev: Draft KMS/HSM integration checklist and estimate (Due: 3/12).
- Finova legal: Please share any specific contractual clauses you require for data-processing, deletion SLA, or logging exceptions so we can prep redlines (ask by 3/09).

PoC timeline proposal
- April 5–16: 2-week hosted PoC (hybrid redaction) to validate redaction coverage and deletion workflow.
- If any showstopper requires it, move to Dedicated PoC mid-April (buckets and keys in Finova account).

I’ve uploaded the MAP and security packet to the shared drive (link in metadata) and attached here for quick reference. If that timeline looks good I’ll formalize dates and pull in our contracts team.

Best,
Marissa
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com | +1 (415) 555-0194
